_README: Negotiated rates that hospitals publish under the federal hospital price transparency rule (45 CFR 180.50). These are prices the hospitals themselves posted, not federal figures and not estimates. Per code and billing class: the lowest, median and highest distinct negotiated dollar amount among commercial plans, outpatient setting, no modifier; percentage-of-charge, per-diem, "other" and algorithm-only rates are counted in notInSpread, never converted. No average is taken across plans. Built by scripts/payer/build_private_rates.py from files listed in sources.
spreadRule: commercial plan AND fee-schedule or case-rate dollar AND setting outpatient or both AND no modifier AND amount > 0 AND amount <= the hospital own gross charge for the line; distinct dollar amounts per hospital, code and billing class
